items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: I worked with Lee Allen in the studio.

ctx.x: Was that the time when you were working with Lee Allen a lot?
I worked with Lee Allen in the studio. Mm-hmm. So it's that period, yes. Mm-hmm. But as on stage, I didn't work with Lee Allen much. He was along with Paul Gaten and that group, Earl Palmer.
And so forth. How did you get involved in production work? Was that through Dave Bartholomew?
